# Commands whole-app reliability delivery assessment

New Patch remained `error` after branch/assignment and restart; Pull rollback removed pre-existing staged, working, and untracked changes. Commit/Reword routes, UI, storage, commit execution, index completion, Reword, and publication guard remained unwired despite syntax/lint in inactive modules. `desktop/process-runtime.mjs` reports non-Darwin targets unsupported. [Task 1]

Scope: console.
